name: frederickmadore/iwac-seo
description: SEO metadata, schema.org JSON-LD, Zotero/Google Scholar citation tags, XML sitemap, robots.txt and Google Search Console verification for the Islam West Africa Collection (IWAC) Omeka S instance.

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan. Omeka S is not a dependency, so the application boundary is opaque — see phpstan.neon.dist.
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Regenerate language/template.pot and compile the .po catalogues.
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything CI runs, plus the static analysis.
